Anna (partnerships): Quick heads-up — aligning staging + HW soak for the Snowflake/Databricks/vector DB connector ahead of marketplace listing. Goal: soft launch in ~3 weeks. Need timeline for marketplace artifacts, cert signoff, SI onboarding, and press pitch.
Miguel (eng-runtime): Re infra: staging cluster + hardware soak schedule are ready, we just need to lock sample workloads. Suggest 72h soak on DGX nodes then a 48h mixed-load run with prefix cache enabled.
Jess (product): +1 on soak. Blocking for product: final schema for connector manifest, example queries, and the demo dataset. I can own the demo dataset if someone else owns manifest.
Samir (partnerships): I can take marketplace listing assets (blurb, screenshots, pricing guidance). Need legal TOC & logo pack from partner. @Olga can you confirm branding/legal checklist?
Olga (legal): I’ll review partner logo license and data processing addendum by EOD tomorrow. If anything special for Snow/Databricks listing marketplaces, flag now.
Miguel (eng-runtime): On tests: can we add a quick regression suite that validates embeddings latency under quantized models? paste below:
```
# run nightly embeddings smoke
pytest tests/embeddings/smoke_test.py::quant_latency -k quick
```
Samir (partnerships): Press / announcement timing note: prefer no press until marketplace listing is live in partner portals. Ops needs a 48h window for listing rollout. Planning: listing goes live -> internal notify -> external announce 48h after if no major issues.
Anna (partnerships): OK so action items: Miguel w/eng: finalize soak plan and run by Mon. Jess: manifest + demo dataset by Tue. Samir: draft marketplace copy + embargo timeline by Tue. Olga: legal signoff by Wed.
Miguel (eng-runtime): I'll post soak run template and a short runbook here by tomorrow. Will tag deploy-bot for soak job kicks.
deploy-bot: scheduled-job created: connector-hw-soak-225678-run at 2025-08-12T02:00:00Z
Jess (product): For demo dataset, can we include a small Snowflake warehouse sample and a DBX Delta table with ~50k rows? That mirrors expected customer shapes.
Samir (partnerships): Suggest we do a small partner-only dry-run with 2 SIs next week to validate onboarding steps. Who can coordinate invites?
Anna (partnerships): @Samir can coordinate invites, @Miguel will provide access tokens for the dry-run. Let's keep the invite list to 2 SI teams + 1 partner PM.
Olga (legal): quick reminder: SI nondisclosure template must be attached to invites. Samir pls include.
Miguel (eng-runtime): Noted. Also adding a healthcheck that fails the soak if 95th percentile token latency > 250ms for gen endpoints.
Samir (partnerships): I'll prepare the SI invite + NDA and share the list here by Friday.
Anna (partnerships): Great. If everyone hits their dates we can publish marketplace listing in 3 weeks and schedule external announcement 48h after. I'll post a condensed timeline and owners in #eng-releases tomorrow.
Jess (product): +1. Will include a short how-to for the demo in the listing assets.
Miguel (eng-runtime): Posting soak runbook now: https://internal.redwood/soak/runs/225678
Samir (partnerships): Draft marketplace blurb attached: "Redwood + [Partner] connector: low-latency inference for Snowflake & DBX-backed vectors." Will iterate.
Anna (partnerships): Thanks team. Quick check-in Friday 10am PT to confirm status. :thumbsup:
